cik.description: Optional SEC CIK string; retain leading zeroes.

company_id.description: Document owner/subject hint; nullable and not necessarily every company mentioned in the document.

content_hash.description: Original collector content fingerprint; not a checksum for this public file.

document_id.description: Document identifier used to join provenance.

publication_date.description: Source observation date as recorded; empty string means unknown, not current validity.

source.description: Claims use uppercase SEC/WIKIPEDIA; documents retain lowercase sec/wikipedia.

source_url.description: Original source URL; availability is not checked by this package.
